We need count of methyl groups in the molecule. But we don't have the molecule description. Possibly the sample is the one we have access to via NMR tools. We need to get the structure? Maybe the system expects us to infer from NMR spectra. Could use carbon_nmr_spectra and proton_nmr_spectra to deduce number of methyl groups. Methyl groups show characteristic signals: in 1H NMR a singlet (or doublet etc) around 0.9 ppm for aliphatic, integration of 3H. In 13C NMR a signal around 10-30 ppm for methyl carbon.

We can get spectra. Use carbon_nmr_spectra and proton_nmr_spectra. Then count methyl signals. Let's call carbon_nmr_spectra.
